preconditions.name: damage_sourced::place_hazard_label_both_classes_present
preconditions.description: min(SAFE frac, HAZARDOUS frac) among scored ticks, worst cell in the arm. This is the SAME statistic the load-bearing AUC criterion routes on: an AUC over a binary label does not exist unless both classes are populated.
preconditions.control: positive control is the random walk itself, which is not hazard-avoiding (the env is stepped with a RANDOM action) so both classes are reachable by construction. Asserts NOTHING about threat_ok's own variance -- a constant threat_ok is criterion (b), a CONFIRMING result, not a readiness failure.

preconditions.name: damage_sourced::z_harm_a_apparatus_valid
preconditions.description: fraction of ticks with a finite z_harm_a norm > MIN_APPARATUS_NORM, worst cell in the arm. Below floor means z_harm_a is wired off/None -- a genuine substrate defect, never a discrimination verdict.
preconditions.control: z_harm_a is an unconditional every-tick forward pass over harm_obs_a (SD-011), never gated on training/convergence, so a finite nonzero norm is the only way sense() returns in practice (V3-EXQ-917 precedent).

scoped_out_criteria.name: ALSO_FALSIFYING_another_conjunct_always_binding
scoped_out_criteria.disposition: scoped out of scoring -- structurally unsatisfiable in this harness
scoped_out_criteria.measured_reason: max staleness_max across every cell = 0.000000; the hippocampal staleness accumulator snapshot stays EMPTY in a wake-only walk harness even with use_staleness_accumulator/use_anchor_sets on, so staleness_ok = (0.0 > 0.3) is structurally False every tick and the staleness conjunct is trivially always-binding for a HARNESS reason, not a gate property. Reporting a narrowing verdict from that would be a vacuous gate.
scoped_out_criteria.what_would_answer_it: a driver running a real sleep loop with episode-end notifications so regions accrue MECH-284 staleness -- named as follow-on, not built here
